title: galium tricornutum f. microcarpum
intro: Galium tricornutum f. microcarpum, commonly known as Small-fruited Bedstraw, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Galium tricornutum f. microcarpum include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and relaxing muscles.
